title: Door Lock Error
shortDescription: The door lock mechanism has failed to engage.
fullDescription: The E1 error code on Godrej washers indicates the door lock assembly cannot secure the door. Godrej is a major Indian appliance brand and E1 is a common front-loader error.

fixSteps.title: Check obstructions
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect seal and latch area for debris.

whenToCallPro: If control board suspected. Godrej has service centers across India.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej washer E1 error door lock fix

faq.a: Yes. Godrej offers doorstep service across India.

title: Drain Error
shortDescription: The washer cannot drain within allowed time.
fullDescription: E2 indicates failure to drain within approximately 8 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Open filter panel at bottom. Drain water. Clean filter.

videoSearchQuery: Godrej washer E2 error drain fix

title: Water Fill Timeout
shortDescription: Washer did not fill within expected time.
fullDescription: E3 means insufficient water level within 10 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Check pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Godrej washers need minimum water pressure. Use overhead tank at adequate height.

videoSearchQuery: Godrej washer E3 error water fill fix

faq.a: Recommended for adequate pressure, especially in low-pressure areas.
Water pressure drops are common in Indian summers.

title: Motor Error
fullDescription: E4 indicates motor cannot start, stalls, or runs at wrong speeds.
whenToCallPro: If motor or inverter needs replacement.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej washer E4 error motor fix

faq.a: Some premium Godrej models use inverter motors.

title: Heating Error
shortDescription: Water heater not reaching target temperature.
fullDescription: E5 indicates heater failed to heat water to set temperature.
whenToCallPro: If not comfortable with electrical work.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej washer E5 error heater fix

title: Water Level Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E6 means the water level sensor is stuck or out of range.
whenToCallPro: If sensor fine but error persists.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej washer E6 error water level sensor fix

title: Unbalanced Load Error
fullDescription: UE indicates multiple redistribution attempts failed.

title: Overflow Protection
fullDescription: E7 triggers when the base pan sensor detects water.
videoSearchQuery: Godrej washer E7 error leak fix

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Main and display boards cannot communicate.
fullDescription: E8 indicates communication failure between boards.
